BUSINESS STUDIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #3
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: BUSINESS STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore prices in shops
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Plan income and spending wisely
   D. Hide all money underground

2. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Avoiding all community work
   D. Destroying road signs

3. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Kisumu
   C. Nairobi
   D. Mombasa

4. Which statement about Types of Business Ownership is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Types of Business Ownership as rumours only.
   B. Say Types of Business Ownership never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Types of Business Ownership with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Types of Business Ownership.

5. Which statement about Procurement is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Procurement.
   B. Say Procurement never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Procurement as rumours only.
   D. Explain Procurement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. Which statement about Cash Books is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Cash Books.
   B. Say Cash Books never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Cash Books as rumours only.
   D. Explain Cash Books with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Name the president
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

8. Which statement about Financial Markets is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Financial Markets with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Financial Markets.
   C. Say Financial Markets never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Financial Markets as rumours only.

9. Which statement about The Ledger is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing The Ledger.
   B. Treat The Ledger as rumours only.
   C. Explain The Ledger with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say The Ledger never happens in Kenya.

10. Which statement about Methods of Price Determination is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Methods of Price Determination.
   B. Treat Methods of Price Determination as rumours only.
   C. Say Methods of Price Determination never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Methods of Price Determination with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. Which statement about Trial Balance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Trial Balance.
   B. Say Trial Balance never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Trial Balance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Trial Balance as rumours only.

12. Which statement about Public Finance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Public Finance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Public Finance as rumours only.
   C. Say Public Finance never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Public Finance.

13. Which statement about Consumer and Investor Protection is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Consumer and Investor Protection as rumours only.
   B. Explain Consumer and Investor Protection with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Consumer and Investor Protection.
   D. Say Consumer and Investor Protection never happens in Kenya.

14. Which statement about Marketing is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Marketing.
   B. Say Marketing never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Marketing as rumours only.
   D. Explain Marketing with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

15. Which statement about Savings and Investments is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Savings and Investments with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Savings and Investments never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Savings and Investments.
   D. Treat Savings and Investments as rumours only.

16. Which statement about Entrepreneurship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Entrepreneurship never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Entrepreneurship as rumours only.
   C. Explain Entrepreneurship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurship.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain The Ledger and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Trial Balance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Cash Books and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Savings and Investments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Financial Markets and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Public Finance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Consumer and Investor Protection and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Financial Regulators in Business and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

25. In three clear sentences, explain Economic Planning and Development in Kenya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

26. In three clear sentences, explain International Trade and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
